label: Exit Full Screen
depicts: Four inward corner marks framing centered empty space inside an open square
use_when: Use when the interface wants exit fullscreen shown by inward corner brackets instead of arrows.
avoid_when: Do not use for the inward arrows variant when arrowheads should point toward the center.

label: Exit Full Screen
depicts: Two diagonal arrow marks pointing inward toward upper left and lower right corners
use_when: Use when the interface wants exit fullscreen shown by inward diagonal arrows instead of bracket corners.
avoid_when: Do not use for the corner bracket variant when no arrowheads should appear.

label: Game
depicts: Oval gamepad body with one centered dot button and one plus pad inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded oval controller with one dot button and one plus pad.
avoid_when: Do not use for the wavy controller when the outer body should curve like a console gamepad shell.

label: Game
depicts: Wavy gamepad body with one centered dot button and one plus pad inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a controller with a wavy outer shell and the same inner button layout.
avoid_when: Do not use for the oval gamepad when the body should stay smooth and rounded.

label: Gift
depicts: Tall gift box shape with a centered ribbon cross and one bow mark above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tall wrapped present with a vertical ribbon crossing the front.
avoid_when: Do not use for the squarer gift box when the proportions should be wider and more even.
